title: First two months at Nha Trang
description: Larry remembers spending approximately his first two months in Vietnam at Nha Trang, on the south-central coast — a period when, in his words, "they didn't know where to put us." Ron Tototz and Parr were there with him; VN-0025 is a snapshot from these weeks.
larrysRecollection: Oct or Sept of 1964, we were there about 2 months, they didn't know where to put us. After we landed he [Parr] was Nha Trang with me. (VN-0025 Memories comments, 2026-08-15)
